precision.amplitude_origin_tiny: original float32 parameter-domain tiny; not float64 tiny

reference_execution.atom_start: runtime offset, fixed chunk and live-row mask
reference_execution.support_discovery: full chart scan for every atom
reference_execution.backward: recompute full physical profiles and H per chunk from immutable forward snapshots
reference_execution.workspace: reused bounded chunk/site tiles; explicit bound including norm/moment/VJP buffers required before source freeze

fixture.width_updates: live original activity law; not frozen
fixture.dense_initialization: separate fixed seed41 weight stream; not CST parameter equivalence

training.mode: explicit existing research Graph update; public optimizer trajectory checked independently

ordinary_cost.prerequisites: all exact regression nodes zero-skip PASS and all 10 numerical workers PASS on identical frozen source/driver/protocol
ordinary_cost.purpose: establish physical-reference cost; not qualify a speed optimization

correctness.oracle: independent explicit physical FP64 + Torch autograd, no runtime math helper sharing; new revision preserves declared amplitude tiny
correctness.oracle_coverage: all sites and atoms; no sampled replacement
correctness.oracle_memory: local chunk VJP with fixed dY; release local graph before detached FP64 Y/dX accumulation; all dP preallocated or exact streamed metrics
correctness.regressions: freeze exact collection and disjoint partition union after implementation and before first GPU submission

measurement.time: uninstrumented complete forward/loss/backward/AdamW/geometry-update Graph step for CST; normal dense step for dense
measurement.oracle_scratch: released and allocator cache cleared before capture/peak reset; after24 check begins only after peaks recorded
measurement.phase_diagnostics: independent trajectory outside primary timing/peak; never sum or subtract

jobs.ownership: root supervisor only; agents do not provision
jobs.partition: one complete worker per isolated job, plus exact regression partitions
jobs.union: every declared case/route exactly once; fixed source and driver/protocol hashes; no partial winner
jobs.failure: retain failed source/raw result; stop qualification for that freeze; no timeout retry or tolerance relaxation

before_submission: standalone research Algorithm/Recipe and strict supported-domain declaration
benchmark-local registry/catalog/cases and complete existing-runner integration
independent oracle revision and meaningful boundary/snapshot/optimizer regression coverage
workspace bound and captured allocation-lifetime review
exact test-node and worker manifests plus frozen runtime/driver/protocol hashes
root source review, commit, clean snapshot and excluded raw evidence

future_stages.indexed_support: same physical precision; conservative outward-rounded candidate bounds, canonical IDs, exact predicate and complete fallback
future_stages.bounded_execution: same support and arithmetic; isolated chunk/storage/fusion mechanism
future_stages.larger_sizes: 4096 then8192 only after preceding complete gates; separately declared domain and full-oracle budgets based on measured cost
future_stages.performance_qualification: >3% complete-step speed improvement OR >=5% allocated reduction with <=3% time regression against valid matched CST control; independent complete reverse confirmation
future_stages.dense_reporting: always report same-shape/batch/task/precision/AdamW engineering ratios; no identical parameterization or learning-quality claim
